evidence.quote: I'd like to talk today about one important element of the international regulatory reform agenda--namely, liquidity regulation.
It makes no sense to allow unpriced access to the central bank's LOLR capacity to count toward an LCR requirement.
liquidity regulation has a key role to play in improving financial stability.

parsed.rationale: The speech concerns the design of liquidity regulation (the LCR) and the lender-of-last-resort role, not monetary policy or the economic outlook. It offers no signal on rates, inflation, activity, or the balance sheet, so the stance is neutral.
